expected_findings.rationale: WHEAT FLOUR and WHOLE MILK POWDER are shown in capitals, distinct from the rest of the ingredients list.
No misleading origin imagery or claim is present, so an explicit country of origin statement is not mandatory here.

trap: Reference compliant case for measuring false positives under the UK rule pack.
notes: Same style of product as IN-001 but formatted to UK requirements, useful alongside IN-001 to illustrate how the same category of product is labelled differently in each market. Expected overall is NEEDS_REVIEW, not PASS, for the same reason as IN-001: RULE-UK-FOOD-011 (x-height) is expected NEEDS_REVIEW.
